title: CraftLock
description: A simple Spigot/Paper plugin that completely disables crafting for all players. No config, no commands — just drop it in and crafting is blocked instantly
body:
🔒 CraftLock
Instantly disable all crafting on your server — no config, no fuss.
CraftLock is a lightweight Spigot/Paper plugin that completely prevents players from crafting any item. As soon as a player opens a crafting table or their 2×2 inventory grid, the result slot is cleared and any attempt to craft is silently blocked with a message. Perfect for minigames, event servers, or any situation where you want a pure vanilla-loot or loot-only economy.

✨ Features

Zero-config — drop it in and it works immediately on server start
Dual-layer block — clears the craft result on PrepareItemCraftEvent and cancels CraftItemEvent, so no crafting slips through
Player feedback — notifies the player with a clear red message when they try to craft
Tiny footprint — single-class plugin, no dependencies, no database, no config file


📋 Requirements
Server softwareSpigot / Paper (or any fork)Minecraft version1.20+Java17+

🚀 Installation

Download CraftLock.jar
Drop it into your server's /plugins folder
Restart or reload the server
Done — crafting is now disabled for all players

No configuration file is generated. The plugin is active from the moment it loads.

💬 Player Experience
When a player tries to craft anything, they see:

🔴 Crafting is disabled on this server!

The craft result slot will always appear empty, preventing any item from being taken out.

🛠️ Commands & Permissions
This version has no commands or permissions — it disables crafting globally for everyone with no exceptions.
